snippet.title: Crank Snake Saga 🐍 | Playdate’s Addictive Retro Snake Game!
snippet.description:
🐍 Crank Snake Saga – Slither, Crank, Survive!
Take the classic snake game to a whole new level with Crank Snake Saga, exclusively on the Playdate console! 🕹️

🎮 Use the crank to guide your snake through pixelated arenas packed with glowing orbs, dangerous rocks, and sneaky rival snakes. Collect orbs, avoid crashing, and use tactical boosts to stay ahead. With multiple game modes and stylish retro vibes, it’s easy to play but hard to master.

🐍 Crank Snake Saga now available 
** https://aicoding.itch.io/crank-snake-saga

🧠 Features include:

Crank-controlled snake action 🌀

Fun game modes: Leisure, Extreme, Time Attack & more

Powerful pickups: Invincibility, Double Score, Orb Magnet

Competing AI snakes with unique behavior

Unlockable skins & trails 🎨

Built-in shop to buy upgrades and sell segments

Global leaderboards to show off your high scores

In-game tutorial to help you get started

📱 Available now on itcho, Playdate!
💬 Let us know your high score in the comments!

🔔 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and crank that bell for more Playdate content!

#Playdate #CrankSnakeSaga #IndieGame #SnakeGame #PixelArt #RetroGaming
